CAN’T FIND THE PLAN NAME?

Do not guess from the code on your card.

Your card may show only a product code, member ID, or group number. To identify the complete plan name:

  1. Check your insurer’s member portal or Summary of Benefits and Coverage.
  2. Call the Member Services number on the back of your card.
  3. Ask for the full plan name and individual/family deductible.

For your privacy, do not enter or share your member ID on this website.

Official sources & accuracy
